message.content: I don’t have real‑time weather data, so I can’t give you the current conditions in San Francisco. If you’d like a general idea of what the weather tends to be like there—such as typical temperatures, cloud cover, or seasonal patterns—I can share that. Or if you’re looking for a forecast, you might want to check a reliable weather website or app (e.g., Weather.com, AccuWeather, or the National Weather Service). Let me know how I can help!
